HowTo.title: Whisking & enjoyment
HowTo.lead: Koicha and usucha differ in water amount, temperature, and whisk motion. Baselines below work for practice and cafés; follow your school or host when in a formal setting.
HowTo.thinSubtitle: Raise a fine foam in the bowl
HowTo.thinTempValue: About 75–85°C (don’t over-boil; soft water is ideal)
HowTo.thinWhiskValue: Fine tines; quick W-shaped strokes front-to-back and check foam
HowTo.thinWaitValue: Don’t over-whisk—done when fine foam covers evenly
HowTo.thickAmountValue: ~3.5–4g+; start with little water and add as needed
HowTo.thickWhiskValue: No foam—slow, even motion along the bowl bottom
HowTo.thickWaitValue: Avoid stirring too hard at once to prevent clumps
HowTo.modernBody: In matcha lattes, milk fat can mask aroma—try a richer tencha or a light aeration to lift fragrance. For soda, powder settles easily; mix well and start stronger to account for ice melt.
